# vectordata fixture

This directory is a vectordata catalog (`catalog.json`) naming one dataset, `polydat-tiny`, whose `tiny/dataset.yaml` declares a `default` profile of six base vectors and three query vectors of dimension 3 (`base_vectors.fvec`, `query_vectors.fvec`: each record a little-endian `i32` dimension and that many little-endian `f32` values), a `u8` metadata facet with one value per base vector (`metadata_content.u8`: 2, 0, 2, 5, 2, 0), and an `i32` predicates facet with one value per query (`metadata_predicates.i32`: 2, 5, 2). The two YAML/JSON files are written by hand; the four binary facets are the output of `facet_files` in `tests/vectordata_fixture.rs`, written by its ignored `write_the_fixture` test (`cargo nextest run -p polydat --features vectordata --run-ignored only -E 'test(write_the_fixture)'`) and held to that generator by `the_fixture_is_what_its_generator_writes`. The tests reach the dataset by name through a `catalogs.yaml` they write under `$VECTORDATA_HOME`, so every read goes through the catalog, `dataset.yaml`, and the vectordata readers.
